text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While researching in the library—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Eh, really, is that okay? I bet I can 
teach you, you know~??

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I shall express my gratitude, 
messenger of miracles. However, this is 
something I must achieve with my own 
power!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Nay... this is "deciphering." Deciphering 
Gabriel's gift, that is.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Look at this cipher.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The letter handed to me was densely 
covered with mysterious symbols spanning 
three whole pages! Was this really a fan 
letter...?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Right?☆ Right?★ Such unique and suuuper 
Marvelous☆★ letters~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I could read it for him, but Gimlet says 
he wants to read it himself☆

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"That is how the style goes; that is how 
humanity was bestowed wine from Bacchus. 
However... it has been nearly two nights 
since I began studying it."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
If I do not decipher it soon, I shall feel 
utterly sorry for those captivated by it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Tanino Gimlet remained 
absorbed in deciphering her fan letters...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Look, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I have finished "deciphering" Gabriel's 
gift—!!
choice_data_list: Congratulations! What was written on it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh—very well. I'll make an exception and 
tell you. You see—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"‘You're always so cool and wonderful. Do 
your best!’ ...it says!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The lengthy cipher that took days to 
decode turned out to be a message less 
than two lines long. I couldn't help but 
feel surprised, but..."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... What a wonderful gift. Not just 
its contents, butâ

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Above all, she threw all that 
individuality straight at *me*.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"This is the golden apple borne from this 
one's aesthetics!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"This cipher itself... is the most 
exquisite gift imaginable...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... How should I reply to this! A 
normal letter would simply be too dull. 
Perhaps I shall compose a cipher of my 
own...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet is in high spirits. The 
unique fan letter seemed to bring her 
immense joy!
